about: Sault Ste. Marie is in northern Ontario, on the St. Marys River opposite its Michigan namesake, where Lake Superior drains toward Lake Huron. The twin cities share a lock system and an international bridge. The Ontario Sault is a steel, forestry, and regional service centre and the starting point for the Agawa Canyon tour train. About 72,000 people live in Sault Ste. Marie.
seoSummary: Northern Ontario city on the St. Marys River, twin to Michigan’s Soo at the Superior locks.
